name: Ranch Dressing
siboNotes: Most commercial ranch dressings are well-tolerated in typical serving sizes, but check ingredients for garlic and onion powder which may trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels as some brands may contain garlic or onion powder
Make homemade ranch using chives instead of onion powder
Store opened dressing in refrigerator and use within recommended timeframe
Shake well before using as ingredients may separate
nutritionalHighlights: Source of healthy fats from mayonnaise base
Provides vitamin K from herb seasonings
Adds flavor to increase vegetable consumption
